info.title: WareStock AI
info.description: AI-powered inventory management SaaS for warehouse and distributor operations.

schema.title: Response Get Me Auth Me Get

post.description:
Org admin invites a user (warehouse_admin or warehouse_staff) to their org.

- warehouse_admin: no warehouse_role needed
- warehouse_staff: warehouse_role is required (one of the 6 operational roles)

get.description: Org admin lists all users in their organisation.
Org admin gets a user in their organisation.

post.description: Org admin deactivates a user in their organisation.
Org admin reactivates a user in their organisation.
Org admin assigns a user to one or more warehouses.
Org admin unassigns a user from a warehouse.

get.description: Org admin lists all users assigned to a specific warehouse.

post.description: Create the initial superadmin account (one-time use).

get.description: List all defined permissions.

post.description: Create a new permission. Superadmin only.

get.description:
List all permissions for a given role key.

Role keys: platform:<role> | tenant:<role> | warehouse:<role>

post.description: Assign a permission to a role. Superadmin only.

delete.description: Remove a permission from a role. Superadmin only.

get.description: List all temporal permissions. Platform admins only.

post.description:
Grant a temporary permission to a user.

- Superadmin/system_admin can grant to any user.
- Org admin can only grant to users in their organisation.

Revoke a temporal permission.

- Superadmin/system_admin can revoke any.
- Org admin can only revoke for users in their organisation.

Create the initial superadmin account.

- One-time only: returns 409 if a superadmin already exists.
- No authentication required (no superadmin exists yet).

get.description: List all system admin users. Superadmin only.

post.description: Create a system admin user. Superadmin only.

delete.description: Deactivate a system admin user. Superadmin only.

get.description: List all helpdesk users. Superadmin only.

post.description: Create a helpdesk user. Superadmin only.

delete.description: Deactivate a helpdesk user. Superadmin only.

get.description:
List SKUs for the authenticated user's organisation.

Supports filtering by category, name (case-insensitive contains), and barcode.

post.description:
Create a new SKU in the authenticated user's organisation.

Barcodes are unique per organisation.

get.description: Look up a SKU by its barcode (must belong to the user's organisation).
Get a specific SKU by ID (must belong to the user's organisation).

put.description: Update a specific SKU (must belong to the user's organisation).

delete.description: Delete a specific SKU (must belong to the user's organisation).

get.description:
List locations for the authenticated user's organisation.

Supports filtering by warehouse_id, aisle, shelf, and bin (exact match).

post.description: Create a new location in the authenticated user's organisation.

get.description: Get a specific location by ID (must belong to the user's organisation).

put.description: Update a specific location (must belong to the user's organisation).

delete.description: Delete a specific location (must belong to the user's organisation).

post.description: Record a stock movement (in/out/transfer). warehouse_admin can do all; warehouse_staff only in/out.

get.description: List stock movements for the user's warehouse.
List stock levels for the user's warehouse.
Get warehouse stock summary KPIs.

post.description: Record stock arrival via barcode — updates the stock level at the location.
Record stock departure via barcode — decrements the stock level.

Record a physical count via barcode for reconciliation.

Stores system vs counted quantity plus the delta. ``apply_correction``
(warehouse_admin only) also writes an IN/OUT movement to align the ledger.

Decode a barcode from a mobile-camera photo (AI vision) and match it to a SKU.

In ``lookup`` mode only the decoded barcode + matched SKU are returned.
Modes ``in`` / ``out`` / ``count`` additionally record the scan operation
(``quantity`` / ``counted_quantity`` and warehouse/location required).

Upload a shelf photo for AI-based item counting.

The image is uploaded to Cloudinary (if configured) and a background
AI analysis task is launched. Returns immediately with PENDING status.
